enable.description: Whether this camera's polygon is painted over before preprocessing.

mask.description: Polygon as [x1, y1, x2, y2, ...]. Needs at least 3 points, so an even length of 6 or more.

normalized.description: Whether the coordinates are fractions of the image size rather than pixels.

max_camera_time_diff.description: Maximum spread between the camera timestamps of one inference, in seconds. A larger spread drops the frame and resets the temporal state.

multithreading.description: Give each camera subscription its own callback group so images are preprocessed in parallel.

anchor_camera_id.description: ROI index whose image triggers the forward pass. Choose the camera that minimizes the spread between the camera timestamps.

is_compressed_image.description: Subscribe to <topic>/compressed and JPEG-decode on the CPU.

is_distorted_image.description: Undistort on the GPU using camera_info before preprocessing.

build_only.description: Build the TensorRT engines and exit.

ego_mask.enabled.description: Master switch for both mask mechanisms. Disabling it turns off every camera_N_mask as well as ego_mask.roi_polygons_yaml.

ego_mask.fill_value_bgr.description: Colour painted inside the mask polygons, in BGR order.

ego_mask.roi_polygons_yaml.description: One polygon YAML path per model ROI index; an empty string leaves that ROI unmasked.

camera_mask.camera_ids.description: Maps model ROI index to camera id: entry i names the camera whose camera_<id>_mask applies to ROI i. Only the first model_params.rois_number entries are read.
